notes: Scout and the 27B decider load Qwen3.8-27B (MLX 4-bit in Bionic, model key qwen/qwen3.8-27b, about 16 GB plus cache); on a 64 GB machine enable them only when other large models are unloaded. Hermes members answer with no tools by default (toolsets 'clarify', which Hermes switches off in one-shot mode). Give a member a tool only when its job needs one, by naming the toolset on that member, for example "toolsets": "web"; "toolsets": null uses the profile's own pruned set. Measured on the local 27B: a scout allowed the web tool took 97 s and searched although the prompt says to judge only the facts given; tool-free it takes 25-55 s.
